items.html: However, Arich Anpin, who is from the phase of the Keter of Nekudim, had no annulment at all in him, as said above; indeed he is from the five lower [Sefirot] of the Keter of BON, as said above. And it is known that in NHY of the Keter of Nekudim there was some annulment when they descended to become Mochin for Aba and Ima, and therefore there were also phases of ZON in it, but a further correction and connection was added to them, namely that both of them were one Partzuf — the male and the female within it — in this way: the phase of the name MA in it was placed on the entire right side, and the phase of the name BON in it was on its left side, and the two were joined together in the phase of one Partzuf.
